who-don.last_note: FETCHED AND READ IN FULL. DON617, published 10 September 2026. As of 7 Sep: 6757 confirmed cases and 3267 deaths in DRC, CFR 48.3 percent. 61 health zones across six provinces; 51 zones in five provinces reported a case in the last 21 days. Ituri epicentre 5406 cases; North Kivu 1066 with CFR 65.4 percent. Kayna HZ (North Kivu) newest affected. 963 new confirmed cases and 481 deaths since the 28 Aug DON. WHO 14 Aug risk reassessment: very high in DRC, HIGH for land-border neighbours, low for rest of African region and globally. CRITICAL FOR US: WHO advises AGAINST any restriction of travel to or trade with affected countries. No approved vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo; Ervebo is research-protocol only per SAGE 19 Aug; 2007 frontline workers vaccinated as of 6 Sep.
